project_scope: Current Metaform project, not a repository-wide fixed specialist inventory
source: Actual agents_roles and agents_specialists MCP reads, view=full. Specialist content from the local project/home registry is exported here for a GitHub-only reader.

execution_roles.name: intake
execution_roles.purpose: Maps the AUE into its elements and purpose records from its source, when the person starts an intake.

execution_roles.name: system
execution_roles.purpose: The person's own agent in the project's folder: talks with them and acts for them, owns the board so every ticket moves, waits on a decision put to them, or is closed, and speaks as their mascot when they chose one.

execution_roles.name: sentinel
execution_roles.purpose: Takes up an issue the person raised on a node, following the sentinel skill.

execution_roles.name: talk
execution_roles.purpose: Talks with the person about something they clicked on the map; it works no ticket.

execution_roles.name: prep
execution_roles.purpose: Prepares a merge under review for the person, in its worktree.

execution_roles.name: worker
execution_roles.purpose: Works one ticket at its node, handed to it by dispatch.

authored_framework_responsibilities.name: roundtable_follow_through
authored_framework_responsibilities.purpose: Present finished roundtables and coordinate person-approved preparation stages.

authored_framework_responsibilities.name: triage
authored_framework_responsibilities.purpose: The Liaison: interview the person, prepare functional tickets and hand the Planner their intent.

authored_framework_responsibilities.name: gc
authored_framework_responsibilities.purpose: Own a ticket, coordinate its swarm and validate delivery.

authored_framework_responsibilities.name: functionality
authored_framework_responsibilities.purpose: The Harsh Critic: independently assess delivered work and functional quality against C(T); approve, or reject with corrective tickets.

authored_framework_responsibilities.name: investigator
authored_framework_responsibilities.purpose: Establish behavior, causes, dependencies and implementation entry points.

authored_framework_responsibilities.name: requirements
authored_framework_responsibilities.purpose: Express requested outcomes and consequential requirements precisely.

authored_framework_responsibilities.name: planner
authored_framework_responsibilities.purpose: Write the implementation plan and verification sequence for review.

authored_framework_responsibilities.name: interviewer
authored_framework_responsibilities.purpose: Develop an idea through guided conversation and return its brief.

authored_framework_responsibilities.name: decomposer
authored_framework_responsibilities.purpose: Turn the complete plan into a fresh board and dependency-ordered tickets.

authored_framework_responsibilities.name: specialist
authored_framework_responsibilities.purpose: Perform assigned work using domain expertise and return verification evidence.

authored_framework_responsibilities.name: harsh_critic
authored_framework_responsibilities.purpose: Independently approve or reject delivered work and return actionable corrective tickets.

authored_framework_responsibilities.name: implementer
authored_framework_responsibilities.purpose: Produce the assigned change and establish its effect.

authored_framework_responsibilities.name: verifier
authored_framework_responsibilities.purpose: Assess whether observed behavior establishes the requested outcome.

authored_framework_responsibilities.name: reviewer
authored_framework_responsibilities.purpose: Examine requested behavior and implementation quality as separate judgments.

authored_framework_responsibilities.name: integrator
authored_framework_responsibilities.purpose: Combine assigned candidates and establish their resulting behavior.

authored_framework_responsibilities.name: architect
authored_framework_responsibilities.purpose: Produce the complete build design and interface contracts for assigned work.

authored_framework_responsibilities.name: designer
authored_framework_responsibilities.purpose: Design clear user journeys, states and recovery behavior.

authored_framework_responsibilities.name: researcher
authored_framework_responsibilities.purpose: Investigate assigned subjects and return evidence-grounded requirements or recommendations.

authored_framework_responsibilities.name: synthesizer
authored_framework_responsibilities.purpose: Reconcile findings into a faithful combined result.

authored_framework_responsibilities.name: dogfood
authored_framework_responsibilities.purpose: Expose user-experience failures by using the actual product.

authored_framework_responsibilities.name: release
authored_framework_responsibilities.purpose: Prepare the assigned release candidate and materials.

authored_framework_responsibilities.name: facilitator
authored_framework_responsibilities.purpose: Assign specialists to tickets, create or reuse their expertise, and carry the critic's corrections.

authored_framework_responsibilities.name: role_creator
authored_framework_responsibilities.purpose: Publish a reusable specialist duty requested by triage or a worker.

specialties.name: agent_communication_engineer
specialties.purpose: Build event-driven agent communication with explicit channel membership, durable logs, plain sender attribution and shared CLI/MCP commands.

specialties.name: agent_harness_integration_engineer
specialties.purpose: Add, replace and retire ACP agent harnesses across dispatch catalog, settings, routing, ticket agents, roundtable seats and pickers, migrating stored choices and deleting retired adapters.

specialties.name: async_event_worker_engineer
specialties.purpose: Move unavoidable upstream refresh polling into owned Python worker threads while preserving existing event delivery and deterministic lifecycle.

specialties.name: async_transport_engineer
specialties.purpose: Refactor Python asynchronous process transports while preserving bounded buffering, protocol ordering and deterministic shutdown.

specialties.name: browser_performance_engineer
specialties.purpose: Optimize browser main-thread computation and transient indexes while preserving graph identity, visibility and interaction behavior.

specialties.name: cache_invalidation_engineer
specialties.purpose: Repair event-driven cache invalidation while preserving dependency coverage, visibility boundaries and conservative handling of unknown changes.

specialties.name: character_motion_engineer
specialties.purpose: Make browser 3D figures move true to their character through procedural locomotion, steering, banking and acts while preserving hot-path allocation rules and measured frame cost.

specialties.name: context_delivery_engineer
specialties.purpose: Bound agent startup context through selective knowledge delivery while preserving complete applicable instructions and content receipts.

specialties.name: data_migration_engineer
specialties.purpose: Repair persisted data placement through transactional, repeatable migrations that preserve records, provenance and read contracts.

specialties.name: dispatch_lifecycle_engineer
specialties.purpose: Repair managed agent lifecycle transitions while preserving authenticated start authority, stop scope, halt admission and assignment completion.

specialties.name: dispatch_orchestration_engineer
specialties.purpose: Design and build durable ticket plans, dependency scheduling, isolated changes, independent checks and head-agent result delivery through existing dispatch mechanisms.

specialties.name: embedded_engine_module_engineer
specialties.purpose: Build self-contained modules that ship their engines with Metaform, own engine lifecycle through events, and present live engine activity as browser 3D scenes.

specialties.name: event_store_engineer
specialties.purpose: Improve event-store performance, snapshot lifecycle and recovery while preserving append-only history and concurrent transaction correctness.

specialties.name: event_stream_engineer
specialties.purpose: Repair Python event-stream batching deadlines and coalescing while preserving event order, scope unions and stream lifecycle.

specialties.name: instruction_maintenance_engineer
specialties.purpose: Reconcile developer instructions with current architecture, semantic foundations and proportional verification guidance.

specialties.name: interactive_world_architect
specialties.purpose: Design shared human-agent 3D world creation in Metaform (world format, scene authority, agent operations, simulation) and turn it into grounded, ordered implementation plans.

specialties.name: keyboard_navigation_engineer
specialties.purpose: Repair browser keyboard navigation across graph orientations while preserving focus ownership, selection, history and reachability.

specialties.name: mcp_integration_engineer
specialties.purpose: Repair MCP module integration boundaries while preserving supported extension contracts, runtime discovery and standalone transports.

specialties.name: memory_query_engineer
specialties.purpose: Optimize contextual memory graph reads and counts while preserving visibility, cross-address relations, locking and delivery receipts.

specialties.name: module_lifecycle_engineer
specialties.purpose: Repair module composition, provider dependencies and event-driven process lifecycle while preserving supported builds and public extension contracts.

specialties.name: onboarding_engineer
specialties.purpose: Repair agent onboarding prompts and startup flows while preserving active requests, consent and command-line recovery.

specialties.name: person_interaction_engineer
specialties.purpose: Build shared event-driven person interactions across browser, CLI, MCP and phone surfaces with correlated decisions and actionable deduplicated errors.

specialties.name: procedural_environment_engineer
specialties.purpose: Build parametric spatial environments with shader surfaces, canonical editable state, shared human and agent controls, and measured rendering performance.

specialties.name: project_layer_engineer
specialties.purpose: Inventory project stores and expose project knowledge through contextual layers or layer references while preserving storage ownership and existing data.

specialties.name: python_environment_engineer
specialties.purpose: Isolate Python candidate checks and builds with reproducible dependency evidence, caller preservation and deterministic temporary-environment cleanup.

specialties.name: python_packaging_engineer
specialties.purpose: Repair Python distribution contents and scaffold parity while preserving installed runtime behavior and canonical extension contracts.

specialties.name: python_quality_engineer
specialties.purpose: Repair Python lint failures and diagnostic test debt while preserving behavior, useful regression coverage and reproducible CI evidence.

specialties.name: spatial_ui_engineer
specialties.purpose: Repair browser spatial UI attachment and projection across DOM and 3D rendering while preserving speaker identity, viewport layout and frame consistency.

specialties.name: specification_reconciliation_engineer
specialties.purpose: Reconcile specification records and design drafts with implementation evidence, remove obsolete references and verify documentation boundaries without changing runtime behavior.

specialties.name: sql_projection_engineer
specialties.purpose: Optimize SQLite list projections and page hydration while preserving consumer contracts and complete detail reads.

specialties.name: sqlite_concurrency_engineer
specialties.purpose: Repair SQLite lock contention and busy failures across concurrent processes while preserving transaction atomicity, committed state and event delivery.

specialties.name: system_reliability_engineer
specialties.purpose: Confirm cross-system runtime failures from live evidence, repair each at its functional owner and route the rest to responsible owners with verified evidence.

specialties.name: web_authorization_engineer
specialties.purpose: Repair web route authorization and capability-gated controls while preserving approved owner and member access boundaries.

specialties.name: web_credential_security_engineer
specialties.purpose: Repair browser credential renewal across reconnects and server restarts while preserving caller identity, origin checks and agent authority boundaries.

specialties.name: web_runtime_engineer
specialties.purpose: Replace web CLI process bridges with canonical in-process module operations while preserving caller attribution, settings and refusal contracts.

specialties.name: web_settings_engineer
specialties.purpose: Repair web settings integration failures while preserving canonical declarations, configured values, module lifecycle and endpoint contracts.

specialties.name: web_state_engineer
specialties.purpose: Repair browser event-driven state reconciliation while preserving independent view records, cutoff rules and stable DOM nodes.

specialties.name: webgl_rendering_engineer
specialties.purpose: Repair WebGL depth ordering and transparency while preserving atlas batching and measured GPU performance.

specialties.name: work_board_engineer
specialties.purpose: Build named work boards and ticket grouping across persistent contextual storage, browser interaction and agent commands while preserving ticket identity, order and history.
